what: anti-Lambda_b0 -> J/psi(-> mu+ mu-) anti-p K+ candidate (charge conjugate)
selection: Offline selection on the DIMUON full DST (not a stripping output): J/psi from FullDSTDiMuonJpsi2MuMuDetachedLine, |m(mumu)-3096.9| < 50 MeV; p and K: Long tracks, ghost_prob < 0.4, track chi2/ndf < 3, pT > 250 MeV, pT(p)+pT(K) > 900 MeV, IP chi2 > 9 to every PV (diagonal errors); p: p > 10 GeV, CombDLLp > 10, CombDLLp - CombDLLk > 3; K: p > 2 GeV, CombDLLk > 0; four-track straight-line vertex fit chi2/ndf < 10 (ndf 5, diagonal state errors); DIRA > 0.999 to the PV of smallest Lb IP; decay time > 0.3 ps; m(J/psi p K) with the J/psi mass substituted (m(mumupK) - m(mumu) + 3096.9) in 5450-5800 MeV. Chosen: closest to 5619.6 among clean candidates, single PV.

masses_MeV.note: m(J/psi p) and m(J/psi K) use the J/psi four-vector with the PDG mass; no full kinematic (DecayTreeFitter) refit.

hadrons.pid_note: DLL* = combined PID log-likelihood relative to pion (ProtoParticle extra info 600-604). NN* = ProbNN read from keys 700-705: plausible values, but the key mapping is not independently validated.
